item.title: 'Dracula's Chivito': Hubble reveals largest birthplace of planets ever observed
item.description:
📝 Tilted nearly edge-on as seen from Earth, the dark, dusty disk resembles a hamburger. Credit: NASA, ESA, STScI, Kristina Monsch (CfA); processing: STScI/ Joseph DePasquale Astronomers using NASA's Hubble Space Telescope have imaged the largest protoplanetary disk ever observed circling a young star. For the first time in visible light, Hubble has revealed the disk is unexpectedly chaotic and turbulent, with wisps of material stretching much farther above and below the disk than astronomers have seen in any similar system.
🔗 Read more: https://phys.org/news/2025-12-chaotic-dracula-chivito-hubble-reveals.html
